'''Resistance Sundial''' is a {{Special}} item. It can modify the player's Damage Reduction.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Resistance Sundial''' can be obtained from {{NPCSprite|Centauri}} during the Healing Revamp Alpha Testing.

== Usage ==
A '''Resistance Sundial''' can be used to modify the player's Damage Reduction between {{Red|0%}} to {{Red|90%}}.
